places.name: The Wound
places.story: The Wound: the place the shafts broke through on the Night of Open Gates, a pit in a sea of fire at the heart of the Deep. The old thing that woke sleeps under it.

places.name: The Sky Isle
places.story: The Sky Isle: on the Night of Open Gates the Deep heaved and tore a hill out of the earth, lake and all, and threw it into the sky. It never came down. Its lake pours off the edge as the Great Falls, straight down into the sea. Skystone grows in its rim.

places.name: The Great Falls
places.story: The Great Falls: the lake of the Sky Isle pours over its edge and falls from the sky into the sea. Sailors see the mist for a day before they see the isle.
